items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1960
items.q: Buster Banks, I taught him how to play saxophone.

ctx.x: What year was this? Well, all right. He doesn't know. Mr. Dewey, would you tell us about your coming back south, about what time you came back here and your reasons for coming back south?

For coming back south, I got in bad health up to Cunningham, and the doctor had ordered me to stop playing. So I came to New Orleans to rest up. while there, after I rest up for a while, Jack Carey asked me to come out to Lafayette to play a dollar excursion as one of the men had taken sick. So I came out here to Lafayette to play a one Sunday dollar excursion, and I've been around Lafayette since. Mr. Dewey, would you explain to Forest students who are young and don't know what is a dollar excursion? A dollar…
